name: Copy of OptiChain AI
description: 1. ML Forecasting Suite LightGBM/XGBoost production pipelines, feature store, backtesting, retrain automation, model versioning.Per SKU × store forecasts with uncertainty estimates (quantiles), confidence calibration, and forecast explainability (SHAP).2. Sell-Through Probability (ESR) Model Probability model predicting P(sell within horizon) using gradient boosting / calibration.3. Allocation Engine (Production grade) MIP-based allocation optimizer (Pyomo/PuLP) to maximize expected sales subject to safety stock, capacity, lead times.Transparent scoring & explanation outputs.4. What-If Simulator — Full Mathematical Engine Discrete-event supply chain simulator with scenario inputs (supplier lead-time shock, demand surge, port closure).Can run stochastic Monte Carlo scenarios and return distributions of stockouts, fill rates, costs.Integration with allocation policy to test policies under simulated scenarios.5. Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization Multi-echelon model (central DC + regional + stores) using dynamic programming / approximate MIP approach for reorder policies and transfer planning.6. GenAI Narratives and Prompt Library Automated forecasting narratives, allocation explanations, supplier scoring summaries, what-if summaries.7. Core Web App Full UI flows: allocation requests, allocation console, transfers, forecasting dashboards, scenario simulation UI, model control panel.optichain ai
